name: Glass SQL query run
oneLiner: a query editor on glass: a SQL query types itself line by line behind a caret, Run is clicked, a results panel opens below and rows stream into the table while the row count ticks up, then the count chip lands green with the time it took
say: when the speaker says they asked the data a question and got the answer back ('one query and I had every customer who upgraded', 'it pulls the numbers straight from the database'): the query types under the question, the rows stream in on 'and there it is'
